_comment: Candidate translations of the corrected Licence §3 and Privacy §4 sentences, carried over from PR #532 (20 Nov 2026). NOT PUBLISHED and not wired into the build: the live locale pages keep their current text until the approved English version is published through docs/legal/proposed/README.md. Machine translation; a translator or counsel reviews it with the approved English text. Each entry: the replaced (old) string and the proposed one, per language. An entry with 'proposed' null is the translation of an English sentence the drafts remove; one with 'current' null is the translation of its replacement (path = [language, English source sentence]).
